svg.title: Stage 3 network architecture with trust boundaries: fictional travel SaaS and a bank
svg.desc: Bank internal network, three firewall boundaries, the internet, the vendor cloud with a vendor-operated connector, and the suppliers and group insurer.
svg.text: Stage 3: architecture and trust boundaries (fictional case study)
Platform opens: F5 suppliers, F9 insurer,
F12 card, FN notices, FL logs
Bank third party reached through the vendor
An arrow points from the system that opens the connection to the system that receives it. Dashed: mediated by the user's browser.
Ports and protocols are assumptions (typical defaults). Four connections open into the bank: FA, F3/F6, F11, F7.
